name: ameb-site
description: Site vitrine bilingue de Services AMEB inc. (ameb) — Astro statique, CSS natif, Cloudflare.

scripts.check: astro check && node scripts/check-content.ts && node scripts/check-parity.ts && node scripts/a-confirmer.ts --check
scripts.test:a11y: playwright test tests/a11y.spec.ts && npx --yes pa11y-ci@5.0.0 --config .pa11yci.json --sitemap http://localhost:4324/sitemap-0.xml --sitemap-find https://ameb.ca --sitemap-replace http://localhost:4324
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build:dev && npx --yes wrangler@4.151.3 dev --env dev
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && npx --yes wrangler@4.151.3 deploy --env dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4.151.3 deploy --env=""
